notes: Complete permanent Budapest Keleti passenger building: monumental pale classical west entrance with recessed arched glazing, clock, paired columns, niches and parapet; full long barrel-roof nave and raised pale-green rooflight; both front mansard pavilions, central and rear side pavilions, low yellow ranges and open courtyard spaces. Preserve the underground metro/plaza relation, independent city blocks, roads, rails and eastern approach ground. No copied lettering, brands, figurative statuary, people, trains or navigable interior. Two adequate ordinary front/aerial pictures inspected. Major roof and facade families are observed. Current map generalizes the low side ranges as closed roof parts; source preserves the visible court voids instead. Four rectangular court controls approximate the two observed near-side courts and the corresponding unpictured opposite-side pair. Exact court outlines, hidden openings, rooflight inventory and present works remain unverified. No bespoke survey/archival research. Original exterioronly. Court positions are observed/inferred approximations within generalized lowroof parts,not an exact mapped court survey. The two metro-relation holes remain outside this model. Figuralstatuary is represented only by simple original crest forms;no copied sculptures orlettering. Physical-device timings andnumericalLODerrors remainunmeasured.
